cohort: Neonatal rats were subjected to induced global perinatal asphyxia, and some received mesenchymal stem cell treatment, while sibling-caesarean-delivered fetuses served as controls.
finding: Perinatal asphyxia induces regional- and developmental-dependent impairment of myelination and oligodendrocyte maturation, which can be improved by neonatal mesenchymal stem cell treatment.
